evidence_slice: Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council's current Manydown page states that Northern Manydown has outline planning permission for up to 3,520 new homes, including 1,400 affordable homes, with a 250-acre countryside park. The page states that the first detailed planning application for a section of the first phase was submitted in January 2026 and that enabling work is progressing before new homes are built. The council's Authority Monitoring Report 2024/25 identifies the outline planning application as 17/00818/OUT and records 3,520 dwellings.
